how_to_apply: Fill the Application Form only in the Online Mode at the Careers Portal of the University (printed in the notice as https:careers.amuonline.ac.in) by 28 November 2026, following the instructions in the advertisement and the User Manual on the Careers Portal.
Pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500 online at the Careers Portal; PwD candidates upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma instead.
After submitting, take a printout of the PDF file of the Application Form on A-4 size paper.
Sign the printout and paste a recent front-facing photograph at the designated place.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents listed below.
Write the post applied for, the advertisement number and its date on the top-left side of the cover.
Send the complete form by post to the Office of the Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002, so that it reaches the office by 5 December 2026.
A separate Application Form is to be filled for each post detailed under a different Serial Number of the advertisement.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The Centre of Professional Courses has advertised 4 Assistant Professor posts in total. The notice does not divide the posts field by field or by reservation category.

rows.fields: Finance, International Business, T. T. Mgt., Marketing

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Nationality: applications are invited from Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date of submission of the Application Form. Relaxation in the percentage of marks will be given as per the rule of the Government of India, wherever applicable. The prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum; meeting them does not by itself entitle an applicant to be called for interview. The notice prints no separate experience requirement, but experience certificates must be enclosed wherever applicable. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each field before applying.

rows.qualification: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline and Master's Degree in Business Administration with specialization preferably in finance / international business / T.T. Management / Marketing or PGDM / M. Com with First class or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: fixed salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month. Work: teaching students of the P.G. and UG level academic programmes of multiple durations run by the Centre of Professional Courses, A.M.U., Aligarh. Tenure: purely temporary till the end of the academic session 2026-2027. The appointment is liable to be terminated at any time without any notice or assignment of reason(s). The number of posts and the salary may be varied at the time of interview. The University reserves the right to get selected applicants examined by an Internal Medical Board.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The processing fee is non-refundable and is to be paid only in the Online Mode at the Careers Portal.

rows.fee: Exempted, in case they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma with the Application Form

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through scrutiny and short-listing of applications, followed by an interview on 12 December 2026. The University may constitute a committee to scrutinize the applications and short-list applicants. The University reserves the right to restrict the number of applicants called for interview to a reasonable number on the basis of Rules / Criteria or any other condition it may deem fit. The list of eligible candidates for interview will be displayed on the webpage of the Centre of Professional Courses, AMU. No correspondence will be made with applicants who are not short-listed. Candidates called for interview will not be paid TA/DA. If an inadvertent mistake in scrutiny or selection is detected at any stage, even after an interview or appointment letter is issued, the University reserves the right to modify, withdraw or cancel the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following documents are mandatory with the application form; without them the form will be summarily rejected: High School & Intermediate / Senior Secondary School Certificate from a Recognized Board Mark-sheet and Degree of Graduation Mark-sheet and Degree of Post-Graduation Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR etc. as the case may be M. Phil / Ph.D. Degree wherever applicable Experience Certificates wherever applicable Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (PwD candidates claiming fee exemption)

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor vacancies are in AMU CPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Centre of Professional Courses, AMU has advertised 4 Assistant Professor posts in Finance, International Business, T. T. Mgt. and Marketing.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AMU CPC Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The online form must be submitted by 28 November 2026, and the hard copy must reach the Centre's office by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for AMU CPC Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline and a Master's Degree in Business Administration with specialization preferably in finance / international business / T.T. Management / Marketing, or PGDM / M. Com, with First class or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of AMU CPC Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The posts carry a fixed salary of Rs. 30,000 per month, though the notice says the number of posts and salary may be varied at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable processing fee is Rs. 500 per application form, paid online at the Careers Portal; PwD candidates who upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for AMU CPC Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Apply online at the AMU Careers Portal, then send the signed printout with photograph and self-attested documents by post to the Office of the Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002 by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process and interview date?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinized and short-listed, and the interview is on 12 December 2026; the list of eligible candidates will be displayed on the Centre of Professional Courses webpage.

faq.question: Q8. Is the AMU CPC Assistant Professor job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary till the end of the academic session 2026-2027 and liable to be terminated at any time without notice or assignment of reasons.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, candidates called for interview will not be paid TA/DA, and no separate interview letter will be issued.

faq.question: Q10. Can OCI Cardholders apply?
faq.answer: Yes, applications are invited from Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955.
